u: Initialize Shared Disk File EXclusiveness Control Program (SF-EX) meta-data.

-n numlocks
The number of storing lock data is specified by integer of one or more. When you want to control two or more resources by one meta-data, you set the value of two or more to numlocks. Default is 1.
device
This is file path which stored meta-data. It is usually expressed in "/dev/...", because it is partition on the shared disk.
